text_block_list.text:
Wanting to protect me from any<n>embarrassment,
Super Creek finishes<n>her debut with a majestic run.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She decides to take on the Classics,<n>choosing to
run in the Sumire Stakes<n>next because of its
adorable name.
